decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core skincare range that remained prominently presented across 2023 and 2024, it likely meets aspiration levels and is worth retaining in a small but established firm with enough slack for a proven line.

Because it stayed on the website in both years and fits the firm’s established natural facial-care offer, management would likely judge its performance as at least acceptable, though its lower prominence than A leaves some moderate risk of withdrawal.

Its very recent 2024 launch makes results more uncertain and a small firm has limited slack, but since it is close to the existing offer and the market context is favorable, management would more likely continue it for now than drop it.
